scenes.setting: The mural's river shatters and nothing changes — Derrick blames a child-shaped shadow, survives the Demon Hunter's dark-green scrutiny, and is ordered to stay at the Chief's side; the mural was not the key

Sixth loop: Jack begs to be sent home to Enmat Harbor — proof of a way to the outside world, and a route that runs back past the Giant King's Court — then bares a chest set with three people's eyes, nose and mouth, arranged into the mural angel's face; 'Rose Redemption!' is no incantation, and the loop resets
scenes.text_anchor: “My home, my home is at Enmat Harbor!”

scenes.setting: Seventh loop, played carefully: Derrick points out the resemblance quietly, and Colin assembles it — Amon's time-worm, a river of fate, the eight Kings of Angels, sons of god — and names the face. 'Angel of Fate, Tail-devourer Ouroboros.'
Evening in the Odora vault: Emlyn accepts the Ancestor's mission, and is asked about his unfulfilled last wishes — which nearly unmakes his knees. 'We can begin now.'
scenes.text_anchor: “Lord Nibbs, I accept the Ancestor’s mission!”
